verdict.rationale: Bento is an agent-observability SaaS with a CLI and dashboard, so offering a downloadable API spec is a fair question for this product. However, every probed OpenAPI or Swagger path returned 404, and nothing in the evidence documents an OpenAPI or equivalent spec. The llms.txt file is a docs index and the CLI is a separate capability, so neither counts as a machine-readable API spec.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
